description: This file contains functions for managing legacy web fetch configurations, including resolving, normalizing, migrating, and listing configuration paths, as well as handling plugin-specific configurations within a larger application.

methods.name: listLegacyWebFetchConfigPaths
methods.description: Returns an array of configuration paths for legacy web fetch settings.

methods.name: normalizeLegacyWebFetchConfig
methods.description: Normalizes a raw legacy web fetch configuration object.

methods.name: migrateLegacyWebFetchConfig
methods.description: Migrates a legacy web fetch configuration, returning the new config and a list of changes.

methods.name: normalizeLegacyWebFetchConfigRecord
methods.description: Internal function that normalizes a configuration record and tracks changes.

methods.name: resolvePluginWebFetchConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the web fetch configuration for a specific plugin from the main config.
